title: Oxva Slim Stick Lemon Lime Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Lemon Lime Prefilled Pods for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit bring a bright citrus flavour to a simple, ready-to-use format. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and delivers up to 600 puffs with a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung draw. The flavour layers zesty Lemon with the sharper tang of Lime, creating a lively citrus vape that stays refreshing from start to finish. Built-in coils inside each pod ensure consistent flavour and vapour output, while the sealed design means no refilling or maintenance is required — just replace with a new pod once empty. Supplied in a pack of two, these pods are a convenient option for Slim Stick users who prefer citrus-inspired blends.
